# truenas_s3_config (Data Source)

Reads the TrueNAS S3 service configuration (s3.config; TrueNAS 27.0 and later). Takes no arguments: there is exactly one S3 configuration per system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (Number) ID of the certificate TLS listeners serve; null for the UI certificate.
- `default_audit` (List of String) Actions audited on buckets without their own audit list; ["ALL"] for everything.
- `default_audit_overflow` (String) DROP or BACKPRESSURE.
- `global_grants` (Attributes List) Grants that apply to every bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_grants))
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "s3_config".
- `listeners` (Attributes List) Where the S3 service listens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listeners))
- `log_level` (String) Least serious log record kept.
- `managed_root_dataset` (String) Dataset under which S3-created buckets get their datasets; null when buckets cannot be created through S3.
- `region` (String) Region name echoed to clients.
- `servers` (Number) Reactor threads serving the listen addresses.

<a id="nestedatt--global_grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `global_grants`

Read-Only:

- `access` (String) READONLY, WRITEONLY, READWRITE or DENY.
- `principal_type` (String) USER, GROUP or EVERYONE.
- `xid` (Number) uid or gid; null for EVERYONE.


<a id="nestedatt--listeners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listeners`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IP address listened on.
- `port` (Number) TCP port.
- `tls` (Boolean) Whether this listener serves TLS.
